name: Kynachi
description: The Kynachi were the native species of the planet Kynachi in the Wild Space. The Kynachi were generally distinguished by their golden hair. Their golden hair was partially a result from their native diet, so those who were not raised on the planet of Kynachi did not share this particular trait. One example was the silver-haired, Coruscant-raised Jedi Master Ring-Sol Ambase.
